name: Claire & Tom, Melbourne
quote: Sven drove us into Iya on a weekday when the vine bridge was almost empty. He knew which bend to stop on, which stall to skip, and when to just let us look. It felt like travelling with a well-read friend, not a script.

name: Anouk, Utrecht
quote: Eindelijk iemand die Shikoku niet behandelt als een mindere Kyoto. De tempeldag was rustig, duidelijk, en nergens toeristisch-druk. Fijn om Nederlands te kunnen praten zonder dat de plek daaronder verdween.

name: The Berg family, Berlin
quote: Two adults, two slightly unwilling teenagers, one gorge. Sven adjusted the walking without making it childish. Lunch was the best udon of the trip — in a place we would never have found.

name: Priya S.
quote: I was travelling solo and nervous about a full-day private tour. It was easy. Clear emails beforehand, no pressure to buy anything, and enough silence in the car. I’ll come back for the coast.

name: Mark & Elena
quote: We had already done Naoshima. Sven took us the other way along the water — citrus, a shipyard, a lookout with almost nobody. That contrast was the point of coming to Shikoku.
